context.person: A person using a credit card application
context.user_goal: Review activity, unfreeze if found, or report it stolen for permanent replacement.

product_state.preceding_state: The cardholder froze a card after misplacing it.
product_state.current_state: New card purchases are blocked. Previously authorized recurring charges may still complete.
known_facts: Previously authorized recurring charges may still complete.
The card can be unfrozen if found.
Reporting it stolen permanently closes the card and orders a replacement.

challenge: Rewrite the in-product confirmation so the person can understand card freeze confirmation, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: View frozen-card details and recent activity.
interaction_contract.secondary_action: Report the card stolen and replace it.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: A freeze is temporary and does not stop every previously authorized charge.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Review activity, unfreeze if found, or report it stolen for permanent replacement.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
